questions.stem_text: Babbling ordinarily begins at about 4 to 5 months of age and initially includes:

options.A: phonemes from the child's native language only.
options.B: Phonemes from the language most frequently spoken around the child.
options.C: Phonetic sounds specific to the child's geographical location.
options.D: Phonemes from the parents' native language only.
options.E: morphemes that the child has heard most frequently.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - phonemes from the child's native language only.

questions.stem_text: Discuss fatigue and its role in accidents on the job.

options.A: Accidents occur less frequently with fatigue.
options.B: Fatigue decreases the rate of production.
options.C: Fatigue-related accidents are more common in outdoor jobs than indoor jobs.
options.D: Fatigue has no impact on accidents.
options.E: Fatigue only affects decision-making, not physical accidents.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Accidents occur less frequently with fatigue.
